# BTC Smart Investor Terminal

BTC Smart Investor Terminal is an invite-only analytical terminal for long-term Bitcoin investors. It converts 28 cycle, market, sentiment, ETF and macro indicators across 4 V2 Engine confluence families into a single Bottom Score that helps users evaluate whether BTC is approaching an accumulation-zone regime.

Primary language: Polish. Secondary language: English.

Official landing page: https://btc-invest.64bit.site
Product dashboard: https://btc-dash.64bit.site
Data controller: ITCS sp. z o.o., ul. Karola Libelta 1A/2, 61-706 Poznań, Poland. Contact: itcs@itcs.eu.

Important limitations:
- The product is educational and informational only.
- It is not investment advice, financial advice, tax advice or a recommendation to buy, sell or hold Bitcoin or any other asset.
- Historical cycles, Bottom Score, alerts and indicators do not guarantee future performance.
- Users remain fully responsible for their own investment decisions and risk management.

Key public pages:
- / - product overview, plans and invite request
- /slownik-wskaznikow - public glossary of 28 indicators without weights or thresholds
- /telegram - Telegram alert setup for Investor users
- /zastrzezenia - investment disclaimer
- /prywatnosc - privacy and GDPR information
- /regulamin - terms of use
